query: Analyze the seasonal variation of vertical oxygen gradient in the Arabian Sea at 100-400m depth range from 2010 to 2020. Calculate the seasonal mean gradient for each season and identify the season with the strongest oxygen gradient.

Calculate the Pacific Decadal Oscillation (PDO) index from 1980 to 2020, then analyze its correlation with interannual anomalies of surface (0-50m) phosphate concentration in the North Pacific subtropical gyre (20°N-40°N, 160°E-200°E).

Calculate the total dissolved oxygen content (in Pmol, 1 Pmol = 10¹⁵ mol) in the Pacific Ocean basin at 200-1000m depth layer for each year from 2000 to 2020. Analyze the interannual variability and fit a linear trend to assess oxygen decline rate.
